description: This PHP class defines a Drupal plugin for migrating date and time fields, including mapping formatters, widgets, and processing pipelines for different date types, with support for date ranges.

classes.name: DateField
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for migrating date/time fields with format and range support.

methods.name: getFieldFormatterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of formatter options for the date field.

methods.name: getFieldWidgetMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of widget options for the date field.

methods.name: defineValueProcessPipeline
methods.description: Defines the processing pipeline for migrating date values, handling formats, and range settings.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Determines the field type, possibly converting to 'daterange' if 'todate' is set and the module is enabled.
